data_science.title: Mixed Poisson diffusion models and application to posterior sampling
data_science.why_trending: Extends diffusion models to Poisson-driven processes, opening new directions for inverse problems and posterior sampling beyond Gaussian assumptions.

data_science.title: The minimal width of neural networks and immersions of real projective space
data_science.why_trending: Provides theoretical foundations for neural network expressiveness through topological immersion theory, bridging deep learning theory with algebraic topology.

data_science.title: MAEM: Mitigating Recency Bias via a Replay-Free, Capacity-Controlled Dynamic Mixture of Experts for Class-Incremental Graph Learning
data_science.why_trending: Addresses catastrophic forgetting in graph learning with capacity-controlled mixture of experts, enabling scalable continual learning on graphs.
topics: Continual learning and graph neural networks

data_science.title: Retrieval Over Training: Similarity search-based Model Selection for Time Series Anomaly Detection
data_science.why_trending: Novel model-selection approach using similarity search for time series anomaly detection, addressing practical heterogeneity across diverse time series.

data_science.title: Scaling Multilingual Mixture-of-Experts: How Language Coverage Changes Capacity and Compute Allocation
data_science.why_trending: Scaling law for multilingual MoE models quantifies the capacity cost of language coverage, informing efficient multilingual model design.

finance.title: GROMM: Generative Risk-neutral Option Market Models
finance.why_trending: First arbitrage-free generative model for European option markets with smooth interpolation, extending SANOS framework to dynamic pricing.

finance.title: Reinforcement Learning with Hawkes-Structured Networks for Market Making
finance.why_trending: Combines Hawkes process order-flow dynamics with RL for market making, addressing non-Markovian self-exciting order arrivals with theoretical guarantees.

finance.title: Data-Driven Dynamic Portfolio Selection with Vine Copula Simulation and Reinforcement Learning
finance.why_trending: Integrates vine copula simulation with RL for portfolio selection under CVaR penalty, combining statistical dependence modeling with learning.

finance.title: Structured SDEs for Realized GARCH: Continuous-Time Volatility Modelling and Component-Level Analysis
finance.why_trending: Structured SDE for realized variance forecasting with component-level analysis, improving upon GARCH and HAR benchmarks with simulation-based learning.
topics: Volatility forecasting and time series models

finance.title: Risk Measures for the Climate Transition Age: Why Symmetric Risk Budgets are unlikely to mitigate two-dimensionally asymmetric Climate Change risks
finance.why_trending: Addresses asymmetric climate transition risk with non-symmetric risk budgets, timely for sustainable finance amid market regime changes.

social_sciences.title: Randomization Inference for Dynamic Causal Effects in Short Panels with Autoregressive Instruments
social_sciences.why_trending: Develops randomization inference for dynamic causal effects under endogenous treatment with autoregressive instruments, advancing causal inference in short panels.

social_sciences.title: Which Text Matters: Handling Model Uncertainty in Text-as-Data Regressions, with an Application to Central Bank Communication
social_sciences.why_trending: Formalizes model uncertainty in text-as-data regressions with application to central bank communication, addressing reproducibility in computational social science.

social_sciences.title: Revealing Structured Heterogeneity
social_sciences.why_trending: Characterizes behavioral content and identification in restricted heterogeneity models, connecting discrete choice theory with structural estimation.

social_sciences.title: Rewarding Noise: Incentives in Decentralized A/B Testing
social_sciences.why_trending: Shows how misaligned incentives in decentralized A/B testing create noise-rewarding mechanisms, with broad implications for experimentation design.

social_sciences.title: Falsification-proof non-market allocation mechanisms
social_sciences.why_trending: Characterizes optimal allocation mechanisms robust to falsification across diverse falsification technologies, advancing mechanism design under manipulation.

topics.name: Generative modeling and diffusion processes
topics.summary: Extensions of diffusion and flow-matching frameworks beyond Gaussian assumptions, including Poisson-driven models and one-step generators. Focus on improving expressiveness and computational efficiency in generative modeling.

topics.name: Neural network theory and expressiveness
topics.summary: Theoretical characterization of neural network capacity through topological immersion, representation hypothesis convergence, and quantization-friendly transforms, bridging deep learning with mathematics.

topics.name: Continual learning and catastrophic forgetting
topics.summary: Methods for sequential task learning without forgetting, including mixture-of-experts routing, recursive self-improvement, and test-time adaptation in dynamic environments.

topics.name: Time series analysis and anomaly detection
topics.summary: Model selection and forecasting for time series, including anomaly detection via similarity search, long-horizon RL, and neural network approaches to noncausal processes.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning for financial markets
topics.summary: RL applications to market microstructure and portfolio optimization, incorporating order-flow dynamics (Hawkes processes), multi-agent interactions in fee markets, and vine copula dependencies.

topics.name: Option pricing and volatility modeling
topics.summary: Arbitrage-free generative models for option surfaces, structured SDEs for volatility, American option boundaries under Heston, and physics-informed neural solvers for parametric pricing.

topics.name: Causal inference and econometric methods
topics.summary: Advanced econometric methods including randomization inference for dynamic effects, rational inattention estimation, pseudo-panel event studies, and high-dimensional inference.

topics.name: Mechanism design and incentive alignment
topics.summary: Optimal mechanism design under information asymmetry, falsification, and strategic behavior, including allocation rules for decentralized systems and pricing under heterogeneous buyer behavior.

topics.name: Multimodal and large-scale systems
topics.summary: Scaling multilingual and multimodal models, vision-language foundation models for medical imaging, uncertainty-aware segmentation, and signal processing with generative models.

topics.name: Text analysis and measurement uncertainty
topics.summary: Handling model uncertainty in text-as-data applications, human-AI collaboration in creative tasks, and LLM evaluation in peer review, addressing reproducibility in computational social science.
